events.content: Chapter 1: The Gelat-oat Opportunity has started.

What is this chapter about?
Teams learn more about the new product they are rolling out for Butterfeast, as well as the different production paths they might use to make the product. They use two financial tools, a Scenario Planner and a Breakeven Calculator, to develop an initial hypothesis as to which production path they might want to support.

What to look for:
  • Do teams explore all of the resources?
  • Do they use each of the financial tools?
  • Do they calculate each of the breakeven points correctly?
Remember to move around to listen to teams' discussions. Sometimes the most insightful comments are said from one participant to another, rather than to an AI character.

Suggestion: You might consider using the Send Message feature to remind participants:

Make sure to calculate the Breakeven for each of the three Production Paths.
Reminder: Move teams to the Decision now.
Decision phase has started.

Decision Time! Teams must enter their initial reflections on the three production paths. The question asks: "Are there any options that you would take off the table? Share your reasoning in a sentence." Their answers should provide some insight into their level of understanding of what they just reviewed.
Timer paused — 0 sec remaining.
Chapter 1 ended — showing feedback.
Chapter 2: Gauging Demand has started.

What is this chapter about?
Teams now try to get a better understanding of the true demand for Gelat-oat. They have been given an initial Market Opportunity Brief by their colleague Carlos. They then interview Carlos to learn more.

What to look for:
  • Do teams explore all of the resources quickly?
  • Do they explore the different scenarios in the Demand Signal Explorer?
  • Do they ask Carlos questions to get a better understanding of how solid his initial projections are?
Remember to move around to listen to teams' discussions. Sometimes the most insightful comments are said from one participant to another, rather than to an AI character.

Suggestion: You might consider using the Send Message feature to remind participants:

Keep chatting with Carlos. Probe into any assumptions being made in his initial assessment.
Reminder: Move teams to the Decision now.
Decision phase has started.
Decision Time! Teams state their current hypothesis for which production path they support. Their answers may also shed light on how well they've understood the information thus far.
Timer paused — 0 sec remaining.
Chapter 2 ended — showing feedback.
Chapter 3: The Recommendation has started.

What is this chapter about?
Teams make their pitch to Zena, saying which production path they recommend using and why. Carlos will also be in the meeting, and teams can call on him to answer specific questions. Zena will push not just for the recommendation, but for the underlying reasoning.

What to look for:
  • What do teams recommend?
  • How well do they defend their recommendation?
  • Are the able to convince Zena and earn her trust?
Remember to move around to listen to teams' discussions. Sometimes the most insightful comments are said from one participant to another, rather than to an AI character.

Suggestion: You might consider using the Send Message feature to remind participants:

As you talk with Zena, try to articulate the assumptions in your model and what you will watch for as the rollout begins.

Debrief Reminder: Now it's time to bring it all together in the final debrief!
